<h:html xmlns:h="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2002/xforms" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:jr="http://openrosa.org/javarosa" xmlns:orx="http://openrosa.org/jr/xforms" xmlns:vellum="http://commcarehq.org/xforms/vellum">
  <h:head>
    <h:title>Register grievance</h:title>
    <model>
      <instance>
        <data xmlns="http://openrosa.org/formdesigner/ec20ffdc" xmlns:jrm="http://dev.commcarehq.org/jr/xforms" uiVersion="1" version="1" name="Register grievance">
          <var>
            <user>
              <username/>
              <fullname/>
            </user>
            <v_today/>
            <v_tracking_number/>
            <v_ack_due/>
            <v_resolve_due/>
            <v_status/>
            <v_zero/>
            <v_source_channel/>

          <s1>
            <category/>
            <description/>
            <urgency/>
            <anonymous/>
            <complainant_name/>
          </s1>
          <s2>
            <tracking_display/>
          </s2>
        </data>
      </instance>
      <instance src="jr://instance/session" id="commcaresession" />
      <instance src="jr://instance/casedb" id="casedb" />
      <instance src="jr://fixture/item-list:grievance_category" id="grievance_category" />
      <instance src="jr://fixture/item-list:grievance_sla" id="grievance_sla" />
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var" nodeset="/data/var"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/user" nodeset="/data/var/user"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/user/username" nodeset="/data/var/user/username"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/user/fullname" nodeset="/data/var/user/fullname" calculate="concat(instance('commcaresession')/session/user/data/commcare_first_name, ' ', instance('commcaresession')/session/user/data/commcare_last_name)"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/v_today" nodeset="/data/var/v_today" calculate="format-date(today(), '%Y-%m-%d')"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/v_tracking_number" nodeset="/data/var/v_tracking_number" calculate="concat('GRV-', substr(uuid(), 0, 4))"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/v_ack_due" nodeset="/data/var/v_ack_due" calculate="format-date(date(today() + int(instance('grievance_sla')/grievance_sla_list/grievance_sla[urgency = /data/s1/urgency]/ack_days)), '%Y-%m-%d')"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/v_resolve_due" nodeset="/data/var/v_resolve_due" calculate="format-date(date(today() + int(instance('grievance_sla')/grievance_sla_list/grievance_sla[urgency = /data/s1/urgency]/resolve_days)), '%Y-%m-%d')"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/v_status" nodeset="/data/var/v_status" calculate="'new'"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/v_zero" nodeset="/data/var/v_zero" calculate="'0'"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/v_source_channel" nodeset="/data/var/v_source_channel" calculate="'app'"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/s1" nodeset="/data/s1"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/s1/category" nodeset="/data/s1/category" required="true()"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/s1/description" nodeset="/data/s1/description" type="xsd:string" required="true()"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/s1/urgency" nodeset="/data/s1/urgency" required="true()"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/s1/anonymous" nodeset="/data/s1/anonymous" required="true()"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/s1/complainant_name" nodeset="/data/s1/complainant_name" type="xsd:string" required="true()" relevant="/data/s1/anonymous = 'no'"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/s2" nodeset="/data/s2"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/s2/tracking_display" nodeset="/data/s2/tracking_display"/>
      <setvalue event="xforms-ready" vellum:ref="#form/var/user/username" ref="/data/var/user/username" value="instance('commcaresession')/session/context/username"/>

          <value>Grievance</value>
        </text>
        <text id="s1/category-label">
          <value>Category</value>
        </text>
        <text id="s1/description-label">
          <value>Describe the grievance</value>
        </text>
        <text id="s1/urgency-label">
          <value>Urgency</value>
        </text>
        <text id="s1/urgency-low-label">
          <value>Low</value>
        </text>
        <text id="s1/urgency-medium-label">
          <value>Medium</value>
        </text>
        <text id="s1/urgency-high-label">
          <value>High</value>
        </text>
        <text id="s1/urgency-critical-label">

        </text>

          <value>Yes</value>
        </text>
        <text id="s1/anonymous-no-label">
          <value>No</value>
        </text>
        <text id="s1/complainant_name-label">

        <text id="s2-label">

        </text>

          <value>### Grievance registered

Acknowledge by: <output value="/data/var/v_ack_due" vellum:value="#form/var/v_ack_due"/>

Resolve by: <output value="/data/var/v_resolve_due" vellum:value="#form/var/v_resolve_due"/>

  <h:body>

    <group vellum:ref="#form/s1" ref="/data/s1" appearance="field-list">
      <label ref="jr:itext('s1-label')"/>
      <select1 vellum:ref="#form/s1/category" ref="/data/s1/category" appearance="minimal">

      </select1>
      <input vellum:ref="#form/s1/description" ref="/data/s1/description" appearance="multiline">
        <label ref="jr:itext('s1/description-label')"/>
      </input>
      <select1 vellum:ref="#form/s1/urgency" ref="/data/s1/urgency">

        <item>
          <label ref="jr:itext('s1/urgency-low-label')"/>
          <value>low</value>
        </item>
        <item>
          <label ref="jr:itext('s1/urgency-medium-label')"/>

        <item>
          <label ref="jr:itext('s1/anonymous-yes-label')"/>

        </item>
        <item>
          <label ref="jr:itext('s1/anonymous-no-label')"/>

  <h:head>

          <var>
            <user>
              <username/>
              <fullname/>
            </user>
            <v_today/>
            <v_username/>
            <v_pending_actions/>
            <v_close_flag/>
            <v_status/>
            <v_reopen_new/>
          </var>
          <s1>
            <pending_display/>
            <accepted/>
            <community_comment/>
            <reopen_reason/>

      <instance src="jr://instance/casedb" id="casedb" />

      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/user" nodeset="/data/var/user"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/user/username" nodeset="/data/var/user/username"/>

      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/v_today" nodeset="/data/var/v_today" calculate="format-date(today(), '%Y-%m-%d')"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/v_username" nodeset="/data/var/v_username" calculate="username()"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/v_pending_actions" nodeset="/data/var/v_pending_actions" calculate="count(instance('casedb')/casedb/case[@case_type = 'action'][index/parent = instance('commcaresession')/session/data/case_id][action_status != 'completed'][action_status != 'verified'])"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/v_close_flag" nodeset="/data/var/v_close_flag" calculate="if(/data/s1/accepted = 'yes', 'yes', 'no')"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/v_status" nodeset="/data/var/v_status" calculate="if(/data/s1/accepted = 'yes', 'closed', 'reopened')"/>
      <bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/v_reopen_new" nodeset="/data/var/v_reopen_new" calculate="if(/data/s1/accepted = 'yes', coalesce(instance('casedb')/casedb/case[@case_id = instance('commcaresession')/session/data/case_id]/reopen_count, '0'), string(int(coalesce(instance('casedb')/casedb/case[@case_id = instance('commcaresession')/session/data/case_id]/reopen_count, '0')) + 1))"/>
